code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    top = next(r for r in range(boundary) if any(v != background for v in grid[r]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out[top] = [8] * w
    return out

code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    boundary = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background)
    object_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v not in (background, 2) for v in grid[r])]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    return out
